I feel like core game play footage could be rearranged. Currently, There are 3 different scenes.
• 0-3 seconds. Shows a ton of matches -- potentially too fast for some viewers to understand what is happening -- unless they are familiar with Match 3D genre. There is no zombie impact shown, so no connection between matching and smashing zombies.
• 3-6 seconds. Slower matching speed, and it shows a couple zombies getting hit.
• 7-10. Even slower matching speed. Also shows zombies getting hit.

If just those 3 scenes were reversed, it would show slowest matching with zombies getting smashed, slightly faster matching with zombies getting smashed, and lastly insanely fast matching -- but no zombies being smashed.
